mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_member (room_id, uid, role, nickname, delete_status, version) VALUES (#{member.roomId}, #{member.uid}, #{member.role.role}, #{member.nickname}, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role = IF(delete_status = 1, 3, role), version = IF(delete_status = 1, version + 1, version), update_time = IF(delete_status = 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), update_time), delete_status = IF(delete_status = 1, 0, delete_status)
